topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 87 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 17 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (swap, ownerpausableupgradeable, shareprotocolfee). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
